protocol.prefilter: Portable JavaScript triangle prefilter and continuous bilinear letterbox with Pillow-compatible byte rounding; matches the training transform.
protocol.geometry: Whole photograph; scale=256/max(width,height), centered padding. No annotation, template or fitted error enters preprocessing.
protocol.comparison: The same held-out model and actual WASM session processes the archived Python RGB and full photo through portable JavaScript. Require exact source, RGB input, normalized tensor and output replay.
protocol.scope: Sixteen development photographs stored as full-size lossless PNGs, reused in place. Original JPEG/EXIF decoding and UI integration remain outside this experiment.
protocol.gate: All sixteen input RGB arrays and inference outputs must match the Python-prefiltered WASM reference byte for byte. No image-dependent parameters.

releaseStatus: Diagnostic only; no website integration or deployment.
